title: The One Word the Lost Colony Left Behind #shorts
description:
In 1590 John White returned to Roanoke and found the colony empty, with one word carved into a post: CROATOAN. And no cross, the agreed sign of distress.

Full investigation on the channel: What Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? I'm 60% Sure Some Survived

Source: John White's 1590 narrative, in Hakluyt's Principal Navigations (1600). Images: 19th-century engravings, de Bry (1590), public domain.

Narration and visuals are AI-generated.
